title: Jessa Blu | KEY.co
description_expanded: - This lovely coastal home is located in Blue Mountain Beach, which has been awarded a national "Blue Wave" designation for the pristine cleanliness of the sugar sand shoreline. This coastal community rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park and is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. Spend your mornings grabbing coffee and pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery and evenings strolling to dinner at Blue Mabel Restaurant. Don't forget to grab dessert, or better yet, don't wait for dessert! Stop by Blue Mountain Beach Creamery after your bike ride or day at the beach to find out why so many argue it's the best ice cream in town. Tucked within the gated Village of Blue Mountain Beach, this coastal retreat is a haven of relaxed luxury on Florida’s iconic 30A. Designed to host up to ten guests, the four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom home combines thoughtful details with modern amenities, offering everything you need for a truly memorable getaway. Start your mornings on one of two inviting balconies—one overlooking the Olympic-sized pool just steps away—before heading out for the day’s adventures. With an outdoor shower, grill, and cozy gathering spaces, this property is ideal for reconnecting with family and friends. The Village amenities, including a heated pool, fitness center, shuffleboard, and seasonal bonfires, add an extra layer of fun to your stay.
